title: Approval of a five (5)-year Reimbursable Agreement with the Federal Aviation Administration: Covering engineering and construction support services for the Taxiway A West and Taxiway F Reconstruction
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a five (5)-year Reimbursable Agreement with the Federal Aviation Administration: Covering engineering and construction support services for the Taxiway A West and Taxiway F Reconstruction Project at Los Angeles International Airport, for amount not to exceed $294,317 (Jacob Adams)
summary: Approval of a five (5)-year Reimbursable Agreement with the Federal Aviation Administration.
